GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-02-19T13:28:44Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Resize -> extract -> rotate leads to no rotate
Description: We have the following code:
```js
sharp()
  .resize(600, 600)
  .extract({ width: 200, height: 50, left: 0, top: 0 })
  .rotate(90);
```

Result should be 50x200 however, it is 200x50 (rotate not applied).

When we do `resize` in a different instance, then the result is 50x200 as expected:
```js
const instance1 = sharp().resize(600, 600);
  
const instance2 = sharp()
  .extract({ width: 200, height: 50, left: 0, top: 0 })
  .rotate(90);

instance1.pipe(instance2);
```

Is this an expected behaviour? If yes, what's the reason for this?

Sharp version: 0.21.3
